The problem of editorial changes to course/program proposals.

that a change should be made editorially (without review). In the case of questions, the affected faculty member should always reach out to the FS office as a first step. 8. Closing Remarks – Recap of decisions made, action items, and plans for the next meeting. 9. Adjournment 4
